measures.id: Proposed Easement for Consumers Energy on City Park Property and Property Within the Chippewa River Corridor
measures.title: Consumers Energy Easement on City Park Property
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Mt. Pleasant may grant Consumers Energy a permanent utility easement, under Article II, Sections 16(E) and 16(F) of the City Charter, to relocate, build, operate and maintain electric lines on a single line of poles along the north side of West Broadway Avenue. The easement includes vegetation management rights reaching about 80 feet into the southern parts of Nelson Park and Riverside Cemetery and 40 feet into the northern part of Mill Pond Park.
measures.yesMeans: The city could grant Consumers Energy the permanent easement on this park and river corridor property.
measures.noMeans: The city could not grant this easement.
